subject: Request: Exec sign-off — 5yr Stability Covenant + Price Protection for Helix Systems
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@helixsys.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-09T09:00:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Exec sign-off — 5yr Stability Covenant + Price Protection for Helix Systems

Hi Daniel,

Thanks again for the productive call earlier. Per our conversation, Helix is evaluating a 5-year committed package (reserved capacity + hosted API for mission-critical workloads). They asked for multi-year pricing protection and clear renewal mechanics — specifically: a price lock for the first 36 months, then a modest uplift cap thereafter, and contractual renewal protection so their unit economics aren’t materially degraded year-over-year.

Summary of the ask: 
- Term: 5 years (annual billing)
- Price lock: 36 months fixed unit pricing
- Uplift cap: max +3% / year after month 36 (cumulative)
- Renewal protection: no unilateral price jumps >5% in any renewal without 60-day notice + right to terminate at renewal if increase exceeds agreed cap
- Commit: $3.6M ARR (annualized) with minimum monthly MRR rhythm (attached model)

Why this matters: Helix is sensitive to long-term operating cost predictability (regulated healthcare workloads). The customer is ready to commit to the volume we need, but they require contractual stability to secure internal approvals.

What I need from you: 
- Exec approval for the non-standard commercial terms above (price lock + uplift cap + renewal protection).
- Any guardrails you want to add (e.g., minimum quarterly price adjustment floor, reporting cadence, SLA exceptions).

Attachments: Helix_MRR_and_commit_model.xlsx, Proposed_Terms_Summary.pdf

If we greenlight, I’ll hand to Legal for contract language (we should include a fallback to a model variant if capacity constrained). Please reply with approve/decline/approve-with-mods.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@helixsys.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Helix Procurement <procurement@helixsys.com>
Date: 2027-05-09T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Exec sign-off — 5yr Stability Covenant + Price Protection for Helix Systems

Aditya,

Appreciate the quick turnaround. The terms you outlined look close to what we need. Two quick asks from procurement/legal side: 
1) Can we set an uplift floor of 1% / year after month 36 (so changes aren’t one-sided downward pressure on Redwood)?
2) We need a defined remedy window: if Redwood requests >5% increase at renewal, Helix gets option to extend existing pricing for an additional 12 months at prior year rates while procurement escalates internally.

We’ve attached our standard procurement worksheet — will fill and return if you confirm the above guardrails are acceptable.

Daniel Park
Director, Cloud Ops — Helix Systems
daniel.park@helixsys.com
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-10T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: Exec sign-off — 5yr Stability Covenant + Price Protection for Helix Systems

Laura / Marissa,

Fwding Helix thread — Aditya outlines the customer ask (5yr commit with 36mo price lock, +3% uplift cap thereafter, renewal protection). Procurement proposed a 1% uplift floor and an option that lets them extend at prior rates for 12 months if we try to increase >5% at renewal.

Commercial impact: this is ~ $3.6M ARR, highly strategic given Helix’s footprint in healthtech and high likelihood of future expansions. Risk: long-term price protection reduces upside if unit cost decreases sharply, but we can protect via contract-level quantization profiles or tiered pricing bands.

Recommend: Approve with the following guardrails: 
- Accept uplift floor 1% and procurement extension option as written (shows good faith)
- Add a clause limiting aggregate uplift over any 12-month period to 3% and require 60-day notice for renewals
- Require Legal to include capacity-fallback clause (auto-fallback to compatible model variant with documented performance SLAs)

If that’s acceptable, Laura — can we get exec sign-off so Aditya can finalize and route to Legal?

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-11T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: Exec sign-off — 5yr Stability Covenant + Price Protection for Helix Systems

Marcus / team,

I reviewed the economics and the strategic rationale. I approve the commercial terms with the guardrails you proposed. Conditions: 
1) Uplift cap: +3% / year (max) after month 36; uplift floor 1% accepted.
2) Procurement extension option is allowed (Helix may extend prior year rates for up to 12 months if they exercise the remedy).
3) Legal to add a hard sunset: no price lock beyond year 3 unless both parties explicitly agree in writing for years 4–5.
4) Finance must sign off on revenue recognition treatment — Marissa, please confirm.

Marcus / Aditya: this is an exec conditional sign-off; Legal (cc me) should prepare redlines and include: capacity-fallback, audit SLA metrics, and a clause that allows Redwood to adjust quantization/instance mix with 90-day notice (protects cost basis). Once Legal produces the terms, I will countersign the commercial approval.

Approved — Laura Bennett
Head of Commercial Operations — Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@helixsys.com>, Helix Procurement <procurement@helixsys.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-12T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Exec sign-off — 5yr Stability Covenant + Price Protection for Helix Systems

Daniel — thanks, and appreciate the quick responses. Per exec review, Redwood can proceed on the following: 
- Price lock for months 1–36 (fixed unit pricing)
- Uplift floor: 1% / year after month 36; uplift cap: 3% / year (aggregate cap 3% in any 12-month window)
- Procurement extension: Helix may elect to extend prior year rates for up to 12 months if we propose a renewal increase >5% (will include process/notice window in contract)
- Legal will add: capacity fallback, audit SLA metrics, and a 90-day notice window for any operational changes that meaningfully affect unit cost (e.g., quantization/config shifts).

Next steps: I’ll send the signed commercial memo and the filled procurement worksheet to Legal and HubSpot. Please expect a DocuSign route from Legal within 72 hours: https://www.docusign.com/en/recipient/12345-helix-ds

Attachments included: Helix_MRR_and_commit_model.xlsx; Proposed_Terms_Summary.pdf

Daniel — let me know if you want to schedule a 30-min call with Legal to walk the redlines once they’re ready.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai
